why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Go to app.nowa.finance (linked from nowa.finance) and connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask. You sign a message to log in; no payment is asked for. Use one wallet throughout.

Enter an invite code. "NOWA is currently an invite-only platform." Without a code, "the first 1,000 eligible users can claim a Scratch Card to unlock access and continue joining NOWA." Whether any are left is not published.
Follow @NowaFinance on X and join the NOWA Telegram, then enter both usernames in the app and press Verify.
Invite at least one new user with your own code. This is required: "NOWA Farming becomes available only after completing the required Mandatory tasks."
Press Request fund to get demo tokens. With all three tasks done you get 100 NOWA and farming opens.
Check the boards. "Rankings begin at 00:00 UTC every day."
